name: Internet Health Pro
release_gate: one shared monitoring engine per plugin process
native ICMP latency with honest TCP-connect, DNS lookup and HTTPS response timing labels
multi-signal outage detection with two-cycle confirmation
ICMP-blocked network fallback without false 100% probe loss
user-adjustable latency, jitter and probe-loss thresholds
manual-only warmed adaptive multi-stream throughput test capped at approximately 300 MB per run
clean Windows and macOS live network smoke
official Elgato Stream Deck CLI validation
deterministic Rat Art and marketplace kit preflight
final_boundary: Final physical pass: verify the new five-second live cadence feels responsive, the 30-second graph remains readable, the Speed key shows download and upload at equal size without clipping, and the Property Inspector/settings behavior remains healthy. If those pass, mark READY_TO_SHIP.
qa_note: Physical QA now confirms the Property Inspector fix is working and the larger typography is materially better. Remaining polish from the final hardware pass: live latency/jitter felt too slow at the old 10-second default, so the default cadence is now 5 seconds with a one-time pre-release migration for existing dev installs; the Speed key now uses a dedicated layout with equally large download/upload values and no cramped retest footer. The 30-second graph and ~300 MB bounded manual speed test are retained.

profiles.reason: Internet Health Pro is a standalone utility and does not promise a bundled dashboard profile. PackRat bundles profiles when layout is part of the product promise, such as Voice Deck and Valorant Tracker.

upsell.note: Do not invent a Lite counterpart. net-spike remains explicitly classified as a standalone free XENEON network probe, not an Internet Health Lite edition.
